messages:
Priya: Acme's support ticket — p95 and intermittent 429s since last autoscale. They say it started ~02:15 UTC. Suspect noisy neighbor on dedicated pool eu-west-1 (pool-id: eu-ded-42). Sharing quick logs.

Alex: Can you paste the tenant_id and the sample span of logs? Also did autoscaler add nodes at 02:12?

Priya: tenant: acme-prod-12
Autoscaler: scaled up +2 nodes at 02:12
Logs:
```
[02:15:03] infer: request_id=ry6k p95=512ms status=200
[02:15:07] infer: request_id=ry6l p95=1700ms status=200
[02:15:09] infer: request_id=ry6m p95=3200ms status=429
kernel: MIG slice 0: SM util jitter, L3 thrash
```

Marcos: Those 3.2s/429s look like slice oscillation. Can you run nvidia-smi topo -m and `nvidia-smi --mig --list-gpus` on one of the hosts with problems? Also paste `driver_log` lines around 02:12-02:20.

ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled up 2 nodes (eu-ded-42) at 2024-08-07T02:12:00Z. current cap=18 -> 20

Priya: Attached outputs:
```
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,mig.mode.current --format=csv
0, enabled
1, enabled
# nvidia-smi --mig --list-gpus
GPU 0: 7g.40gb (slices: 2)
GPU 1: 7g.40gb (slices: 2)
# driver:
[02:15:08] nvidia: MIG slice 0 eviction_detected
[02:15:09] nvidia: sm_throttle_event slice=1
```

Lina: Oncall here — I can repro quickly. Running a 100qps token-heavy replay against acme model: model_id=xlarge-v2-open, 1k tokens/req. Using the standard loadgen:
```
for i in `seq 1 60`; do curl -s -XPOST https://api.redwood/run -d '{"model":"xlarge-v2-open","tokens":1000}' & done
```
Got several 429s after ~90s and host-level SM saturation spikes.

Alex: Two hypotheses: (1) fractional MIG packing + bursty warmup leading to SM oversubscription and eviction; (2) autoscaler added nodes but scheduler packed slices poorly and placed multiple noisy tenants on same physical GPU.

Priya: Customer asks for quick mitigation — can we temporarily disable fractional packing for their pool or move them to an exclusive node? They prefer no restart windows unless necessary.

Marcos: Quick mitigation: 1) bump pool capacity to add exclusive slot via `pool.set_preferred_isolation(acme-prod-12, true)` (requires maintenance), 2) toggle fractional packing off for eu-ded-42 (hot path) — this will reduce density but improve isolation. Either will need a rolling reprovision for a few pods.

Priya: Customer (jdoe-acme) — can we move you to an exclusive slice for the next 2 hours while we confirm? It should be seamless but we'll migrate traffic.

jdoe-acme: yes please, move. we're seeing user impact.

Lina: I'll schedule a quick reallocation; plan: 1) create isolation slot, 2) drain and move two pods from noisy hosts, 3) monitor p95 for 30m. ETA 15m. @Marcos can you watch driver logs during move?

Marcos: On it. Will tail /var/log/nvidia-driver.log and post any eviction lines.

Priya: Noted. We'll follow up in 45m with metrics. Thanks all :thumbsup:
